messages:
Diego Marquez: Heads-up — customer POC stalled because CPQ routed a 12-month commit to Sales Ops. We need Deal Desk for >=6 months or discounts > 20%.
Hannah Cole: Oof. Which fields are we checking now?
Diego Marquez: Current rule only checks `Price_Exception__c` boolean. No commit or discount thresholds.
Samir Patel: Suggestion: compute `Route_To_DealDesk__c` with logic: ```
if Commit_Months__c >= 6 or Discount_Percent__c > 20% or Legal_Amendment__c == true:
  Route_To_DealDesk__c = true
else:
  Route_To_DealDesk__c = false
```
Hannah Cole: Also set `DealDesk_Reason__c` values: `commit-length`, `discount`, `legal`, `security`, `manual`. Makes filtering easy.
Diego Marquez: SLA: sales wants a promise. Proposed `Approval_SLA_Hours__c`: 24 (<=50k), 48 (50k-250k), 72 (>250k or legal).
Samir Patel: Add `SLA_Expires_At__c` timestamp for auto-escalation; when expired set `Auto_Escalated__c = true` and ping `#deal-desk-escalations`.
ops-bot: created ticket DD-1301 for CPQ routing update (owner: @Samir Patel) — https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/DD-1301 :white_check_mark:
Hannah Cole: I'll prepare a short test matrix and SOQL checks. Example SOQL: ```sql
SELECT Id, Commit_Months__c, Discount_Percent__c, Route_To_DealDesk__c, DealDesk_Reason__c, Approval_SLA_Hours__c FROM Opportunity WHERE Id = 'oppty-9001'
```
Samir Patel: I'll patch sandbox tomorrow, run tests, and post results here.
Diego Marquez: Thanks — if sandbox looks good let's flip in staging and update the sales playbook with exact SLA wording. :rocket:
